items.question: What is Supreme One Software?
items.answer: A product studio and communication platform company, established in 2025. We build messaging, voice and custom software for businesses.

items.question: What products do you offer?
items.answer: Eleven communication products (WhatsApp Business API, RCS, IVR, Facebook and Instagram Automation, No-Code Chatbot, Campaigns, Unified Team Inbox, E-Commerce Solutions, Form Builder and AI Reviews) plus custom mobile app and website development.

items.question: Do I need technical skills to use the platform?
items.answer: No. The chatbot builder, campaigns, inbox and forms are no-code and designed for marketing and support teams. Developers are only needed if you want custom API integrations.

items.question: Which industries do you work with?
items.answer: Retail and e-commerce, healthcare, education, real estate, hospitality and travel, restaurants, BFSI, automotive, salons and wellness, and logistics. The platform works for any business that talks to customers.

items.question: What is the WhatsApp Business API and how is it different from the WhatsApp Business app?
items.answer: The WhatsApp Business app is built for a single phone and a small team. The WhatsApp Business API is built for scale: multiple agents on one number, automation, broadcast campaigns, and integration with your CRM or store.

items.question: Do you help with Meta verification and template approval?
items.answer: Yes. We guide you through linking your Meta Business Manager, applying for the API, and getting message templates approved.

items.question: Can I manage WhatsApp, Instagram and Facebook in one place?
items.answer: Yes. The Unified Team Inbox brings WhatsApp, Instagram, Facebook and web chat into one shared inbox.

items.question: Do you support phone calls as well as messaging?
items.answer: Yes. IVR Solutions lets you answer calls with a voice menu, route callers to the right team, and send a WhatsApp follow-up after a missed call.

items.question: How much does it cost?
items.answer: Pricing depends on the products you use and your message volume — see our pricing page or ask us for a custom quote. WhatsApp message charges set by Meta are billed in addition to platform fees.

items.question: How long does setup take?
items.answer: We set the platform up with you as part of onboarding. Meta verification time depends on Meta’s review queue — we’ll confirm a current estimate during onboarding.

items.question: Can I see a demo before I decide?
items.answer: Yes. Use the Book a Demo button on any page and we’ll walk you through the platform using your own use case.

items.question: What support do you offer?
items.answer: [Add support channels and hours — e.g. email, phone, WhatsApp — and typical response times, then publish.]

items.question: Can you build a custom app or website for us?
items.answer: Yes. Our engineering team builds Android and iOS apps and websites, and connects them to the same backend as your messaging stack.

items.question: Can the platform connect to my CRM or online store?
items.answer: Yes. Common connections include Shopify, WooCommerce, Salesforce, Zoho, HubSpot and Google Sheets, and other systems can be connected through the API.

items.question: What should I include in my message?
items.answer: The channels you use today, what you’d like to automate, and any systems — CRM, online store, spreadsheet — we’d need to connect to.

items.question: Do you help with WhatsApp Business API setup?
items.answer: Yes. We guide you through Meta verification, linking your Meta Business Manager and getting message templates approved.
